new_capabilities.name: api_key_cyber_access_programs
new_capabilities.reason: access programs of an API-key login; Veldo runs only the ChatGPT login (forced_login_method chatgpt); on and off it sends the identical model request on loopback (tools, instructions and fields; scratch probe of 2026-11-03)

new_capabilities.name: api_key_model_discovery
new_capabilities.reason: remote model discovery for an API-key login; Veldo runs only the ChatGPT login and the bundled catalog; on and off it sends the identical model request on loopback (tools, instructions and fields; scratch probe of 2026-11-03)

new_capabilities.name: bedrock_setup_wizard
new_capabilities.reason: the TUI wizard that sets up the Bedrock provider; codex exec has no TUI and Veldo's provider is the subscription; on and off it sends the identical model request on loopback (tools, instructions and fields; scratch probe of 2026-11-03)

new_capabilities.name: browser_annotation_api
new_capabilities.reason: annotations of the desktop app's in-app browser, which codex exec does not have (the browser tool sources stay ungranted); on and off it sends the identical model request on loopback (tools, instructions and fields; scratch probe of 2026-11-03)

new_capabilities.name: cli_daybreak
new_capabilities.reason: the TUI's Daybreak account-eligibility check (tui/src/app_server_session); codex exec does not run it; on and off it sends the identical model request on loopback (tools, instructions and fields; scratch probe of 2026-11-03)

new_capabilities.name: code_mode_interrupt
new_capabilities.reason: a running Code Mode cell can be interrupted, so a stopped or timed-out run ends its cell; no tool; on and off it sends the identical model request on loopback (tools, instructions and fields; scratch probe of 2026-11-03)

new_capabilities.name: daemon_auto_start
new_capabilities.reason: starts the local app-server daemon, a process that outlives the run

new_capabilities.name: guardian_reuse_parent_compaction
new_capabilities.reason: the approval guardian reuses the parent's compacted context, fewer tokens per assessment; no tool; on and off it sends the identical model request on loopback (tools, instructions and fields; scratch probe of 2026-11-03)

new_capabilities.name: in_app_voice
new_capabilities.reason: voice input of the desktop app; on and off it sends the identical model request on loopback (tools, instructions and fields; scratch probe of 2026-11-03)

new_capabilities.name: incremental_tools
new_capabilities.reason: a later request declares only the tools that changed (an additional_tools item after "This is an incremental tools update. Previously declared tools remain available..."), so later requests are smaller; the wire comparison reads every request of a run and the tools declared by then, so a tool the role does not list is refused wherever it is first declared (VELDO-0127 AC4; owner Telegram 38895-38896; loopback capture of 2026-11-03, proof/VELDO-0230/fix3-incremental-capture.json)

new_capabilities.name: instant_interrupt
new_capabilities.reason: an interrupt takes effect at once, so a stop ends the turn sooner; no tool; on and off it sends the identical model request on loopback (tools, instructions and fields; scratch probe of 2026-11-03)

new_capabilities.name: mcp_oauth_refresh_coordination
new_capabilities.reason: coordinates OAuth refresh of MCP servers across processes; Veldo delivers MCP credentials itself (VELDO-0158) and the run's CODEX_HOME holds no OAuth store; on and off it sends the identical model request on loopback (tools, instructions and fields; scratch probe of 2026-11-03)

new_capabilities.name: plugin_discovery_prefetch
new_capabilities.reason: prefetches the plugin marketplace over the network; plugins are no source of a Veldo run

new_capabilities.name: prediction_preserve_parent_tools
new_capabilities.reason: the app server's prediction mode keeps the parent thread's tools; codex exec has no prediction thread; on and off it sends the identical model request on loopback (tools, instructions and fields; scratch probe of 2026-11-03)

new_capabilities.name: realtime_conversation
new_capabilities.reason: realtime voice conversations of the TUI and app; on and off it sends the identical model request on loopback (tools, instructions and fields; scratch probe of 2026-11-03)

new_capabilities.name: reasoning_effort_override
new_capabilities.reason: a reasoning effort set for the run applies over the model default; no tool; on and off it sends the identical model request on loopback (tools, instructions and fields; scratch probe of 2026-11-03)

new_capabilities.name: system_proxy_fallback
new_capabilities.reason: a failed OAuth token exchange retries through the host's system proxy, as the kept proxy variables already allow; keeps the subscription login refreshing; on and off it sends the identical model request on loopback (tools, instructions and fields; scratch probe of 2026-11-03)

new_capabilities.name: ultrafast_mode
new_capabilities.reason: the faster service mode, the same class as fast_mode, which Veldo already leaves on; no tool; on and off it sends the identical model request on loopback (tools, instructions and fields; scratch probe of 2026-11-03)

new_capabilities.name: worktrees
new_capabilities.reason: creates managed git worktrees outside the run's clone

new_capabilities.name: write_stdin_approval
new_capabilities.reason: asks approval before writing to a running exec session; a Veldo run never asks for approval (codex exec's policy is never); on and off it sends the identical model request on loopback (tools, instructions and fields; scratch probe of 2026-11-03)
